name: POST /api/leadflow/payments/verify - the gate on Closed Won
description:
Records a gateway payment verification, and it is the ONLY thing that opens Closed Won (b6072947-1983-41b2-8b5b-2a7537ab4b46#AC1). An intent is not a verification: SOP §22 names "payment success assumed from checkout intent" as the gap, so the two are stored as different values rather than one boolean, and only gateway_confirmed returns may_close_won true. A checkout the buyer started and a charge the gateway confirmed are different facts about the world.

REPLAY PRODUCES EXACTLY ONE OF EVERY ARTIFACT (b6072947-1983-41b2-8b5b-2a7537ab4b46#AC2), guaranteed by a UNIQUE constraint on (tenant, charge_ref) with INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING - not by a check-then-write, which has a window that five concurrent webhook deliveries will find. The second call returns 200 with duplicate true rather than 201, so a caller can tell what happened without the outcome changing.

A MISSING WEBHOOK QUERIES THE GATEWAY DIRECTLY AND OPENS A FINANCE TASK (b6072947-1983-41b2-8b5b-2a7537ab4b46#AC3). source=missing_webhook probes sdk-payment and records the answer honestly: an unreachable gateway leaves the charge unconfirmed and Closed Won blocked, because assuming success here is the exact failure the SOP names. The finance task is opened either way, since a webhook that never arrived is a fact somebody must reconcile whichever way the probe lands.

QA: depends on register and login. The happy path posts a fresh charge reference; re-running the suite re-posts the same reference and correctly returns 200 duplicate, which is the guarantee rather than a flake.

testCases.name: A gateway-confirmed charge is recorded once and permits Closed Won
A checkout intent is recorded as intent_only and does NOT permit Closed Won
NEGATIVE: no Authorization header at all
NEGATIVE: a bearer token that does not verify

errorCases.when: subject_ref or charge_ref is absent or empty - the charge reference is the idempotency key, so a verification without one cannot be deduplicated.

errorCases.message: Authorization header with a bearer token is required
errorCases.when: the Authorization header is absent, empty, or uses a scheme other than Bearer.

errorCases.message: Session token is invalid or expired
errorCases.when: a Bearer token was presented but does not verify.
